content.heroIntro: A quiet place where ancient machines sleep beneath the wild. I create motion, characters and small worlds for people who still look closely.
content.aboutText: Hey, I’m Nyx.aex. I’m an independent artist drawn to forgotten places, gentle oddities and the way nature takes its time. Through animation and design, I build little windows into worlds that might have existed — or might still.
content.aboutAside: This portfolio is a living notebook. More stories are on their way.
content.commissionText: I’m available for select animation, illustration and motion design projects. If your idea feels like a good fit, tell me a little about it.
content.contactText: For project inquiries, collaborations or just to share something lovely you found.
